Amenities: Lake view
Description: Villa by the Lake  An Eco-Luxury Landmark in Southern Sri Lanka We are proud to present an extraordinary opportunity to become the foundational investor in Villa by the Lake , Sri Lankas first and only large-scale eco-luxury resort set within an internationally protected Ramsar Wetland. This is far more than a hotel project; it is the creation of a world-class, sustainable destination at a time when global demand for authentic, nature-led luxury experiences is soaring. Read More A Location of Global Privilege Villa by the Lake is located within the Madu Ganga Ramsar Wetland in Southern Sri Lanka , a site of international ecological importance. Only a handful of destinations worldwide enjoy such rare, protected status, placing this project in a category of its own. With all approvals in place, including environmental, land, and design permissions, this is a fully sanctioned project ready to move forward. The property spans 340 perches of prime land bordering the Madu River and its iconic Floating Temple . Surrounded by labyrinthine mangroves, freshwater lakes, and diverse birdlife, guests will not merely observe nature but live within it an immersive experience unlike any other in Sri Lanka. Perfect Timing in a Tourism Super-Cycle Southern Sri Lanka is experiencing record-breaking growth, emerging as the countrys fastest-rising tourism hub. The 2024/25 season is forecast to be the strongest in the nations history. The location offers unrivalled connectivity to high-value attractions including the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Galle Fort, the golden beaches of Bentota, and the marine sanctuary of Hikkaduwa. The resort will cater to discerning travellers seeking both exclusivity and access to the best of Sri Lankas South. A De-Risked and Construction-Ready Project This opportunity is not conceptualit is ready to build. All approvals are already secured. Foundational infrastructure is in place, significantly accelerating the timeline to market entry. Our phased approach begins with a boutique collection of eight to ten luxury villas, designed to establish brand prestige and generate early cash flow, before expanding to 2530 villas. This model reduces upfront capital risk while optimising long-term investor returns. Authentic Sustainability and Cultural Integration Villa by the Lake is designed to set new benchmarks for sustainable tourism. Plans include renewable energy integration, low-impact architecture, and LEED certification standards. Operational efficiency will be maximised by outsourcing non-core services, ensuring lean and eco-conscious management practices. Beyond sustainability, the project celebrates Sri Lankas cultural heritagefrom artisan crafts and sculpture-making to journeys through cinnamon production. The result is an authentic, conservation-led luxury experience that cannot be replicated by conventional resorts. A Destination Poised to Become Iconic By uniting ecological prestige, cultural depth, and uncompromising luxury, Villa by the Lake is set to become Sri Lankas next must-visit destination. It represents a rare convergence of protected natural assets, ideal timing, risk-mitigated execution, and alignment with the global shift towards purposeful luxury travel. Invitation to Strategic Partners We are seeking a visionary investor or strategic partner to secure equity participation and co-brand this landmark development for international markets. This is a unique opportunity to shape a destination that is ready to build, fully approved, and positioned to become a legendary benchmark in sustainable tourism.

Large variety of fruit trees including rambutan, mangosteen, orange, etc.
Roads have been cut to access almost all parts of the estate.
Located 20 minutes from Kurunegala town, and with the new central highway, it is 1.5 hours from Colombo, and 1 hour from Kandy.

Title: Sea views serenity in Unawatuna on the mythical mountain of Rumassala
Amenities: BEACHFRONT   SEA VIEW, 3 PHASE ELECTRICITY, IDEAL FOR COMMERCIAL USE, APPROVED SURVEY PLAN, PIPE BORNE WATER, BUNGALOW   COTTAGE INSIDE, HILLY LANDSCAPE, LAKE POND INSIDE LAND
Description:
Unique Land for Sale   Unawatuna's Rumassal Mountain, (210 Perches remaining)
Discover a rare opportunity to own 210 perches at the top of the legendary Rumassal Mountain in Unawatuna directly off the main road to Jungle Beach and just a short walk from its pristine shores.
This elevated property offers spectacular views of the Indian Ocean, the iconic Galle Fort, and the lush southern mountains. Here, you can design a home that captures the beauty of Sri Lanka s cool misty mornings, warm days, and breezy evenings, while enjoying the tranquility of a multi-ethnic local community.
Steeped in history and myth, Rumassal Mountain is tied to the Ramayana epic specifically the story of Hanuman and the Sanjeevani mountain (Google it)   making this location truly one-of-a-kind.
Location Highlights:
A few minutes  walk to the Japanese Peace Pagoda (Temple)
7-minute drive to the Southern Expressway entrance
10-15 minute drive to the UNESCO-listed colonial city of Galle
Property Features:
Fully fenced land with breathtaking elevations and panoramic views
Majestic rock formations, a natural rock pool, mature trees, and diverse wildlife (including deer and exotic birds)
Spices, herbs, and fruit trees that have been cultivated over the years
Electricity and city water connections
Small property manager s cottage on-site
Direct main road access leading to the ocean and Jungle Beach
We grew up spending our summers here.  Our family envisioned this as a private sanctuary preserving local flora and fauna. My uncle spent years protecting this property's biodiversity. Sadly, with my uncle s passing, we can no longer fulfill that dream. The property is legally subdivided, with a clear title and all documentation in order.
We are offering this land at a fair and competitive price. 90 perches have already been sold or are under contract.  We are hoping to find a buyer who values its natural beauty, heritage, and unique character.
If you seek a crowded tourist hub, this may not be for you. But if you long for peace, culture, and nature this is a must-see.

Exceptionally well positioned, rectangular beach land with 330 feet of beach frontage. Extending to 1.8 acres, the plot is situated on the North West coast of Sri Lanka in a small fishing village called Mukkuthoduwawa, close to the popular tourist resort of Kalpitiya.

Madel fishing is said to be the oldest method of fishing in Sri Lanka using extremely long nets which are spread in the ocean from a boat and then dragged ashore by dozens of men. It is a spectacular and colourful sight which many tourists come to see and photograph. The licence is issued by the Department of Fisheries and only people who own the licence can catch fish in the sea within the demarcated lines. Licence ownership is normally passed within the family members  hence it is very rare for a licence to come up for sale. Furthermore, there are three boats and three boat licences to be included part of the fishing licence sale.

Title: A Beautiful Coconut Estate within a 2-minute drive from the Nakalagamuwa Interchange on the Colombo-Kandy Highway.
Amenities: 3 PHASE ELECTRICITY, IDEAL FOR COMMERCIAL USE, APPROVED SURVEY PLAN, SOIL TEST PASSED, PIPE BORNE WATER, STREAM RUNNING THROUGH LAND, BUNGALOW   COTTAGE INSIDE, LAKE POND INSIDE LAND
Description:
This is an excellent opportunity for use as a commercial farm, a retirement property, or an eco-project.  This coconut estate was designed and cultivated by a professional Australian agriculturist with modern irrigation and fertigation (fertilizer delivery through the irrigation system   requires less fertilizer for the same impact) systems.  The trees are planted scientifically with the prescribed distance between the trees to maximize yield and to allow intercropping.  There is a two-bedroomed modern house on the land which can be used as a weekend getaway.  Attached toilet, sitting room, kitted with pantry cupboards etc.  The estate has multiple superb water sources   a one-acre well, a large agriculture well, a smaller well for drinking water, a smaller lake of about a quarter of an acre and a two perennial streams flowing through the estate.  The estate also features a 2-acre paddy field   our family has never had to buy paddy from outside   we have planted our own varieties of paddy over the past decade   healthy and organic.  The estate has multiple fruit trees, planted in an orchard-style setting   jackfruit, Sri Lankan tangerine (narang), guava (pera), banada, papaya, tamarind, breadfruit (del), stone-apple (beli) and many other fruit trees.  The estate has also been planted with numerous teak and mahogany trees.  There are multiple pathways and roads within the estate that allow easy access to all the coconut trees at the time of plucking.  Yield varies seasonally and maximum yield enjoyed was around 25,000 nuts per plucking.  The estate also has foundation laid upto ground floor level for a second bungalow.  This is set within the fruit orchard.  This is intended to be the owner's holiday retirement home.  The estate boasts of a large warehouse for storing plucked coconut and produce, along with a small living quarters, copra drying hut (cement) and a large pump-house next to the lake.  The pump-house contains a massive water irrigation system which was installed by Jinasena Ltd.  Contains a 5000 sqft. greenhouse used to grow orchids for export.  Sale price includes 1 recently purchased, TAFE agricultural tractor with trailer and two grass-cutting attachments, and a Kubota tractor for tilling the paddy fields.  The estate is located within a 2-minute drive from the Nakalagamuwa exit of the Colombo-Kandy highway.  At the moment, the estate is a 10-minute drive from the Mirigama interchange.  Once the Kadawatha-Mirigama portion of the Colombo-Kandy highway is completed, the estate will be a mere 30-minute drive from Colombo and a 20-minute drive from the Banadaranaike International Airport.
